slug: 2025-03-19 E-Houwiya - A Milestone in Tunisia's Digital Transformation Roadmap 2025 (ID Tech)

facts.fact: The former communications technology minister who led its design writes that E-Houwiya is open to the banking sector for remote onboarding and KYC compliance under Central Bank of Tunisia rules published 28 February 2025.
The author describes E-Houwiya as used in banking (onboarding, wire transfers) and in government portals, including E-CNAM, E-CNSS and Madrassati.
